p: elder unto the wellbeloved Gaius: An example of a Christian greeting.
to hear that my children walk: Than these joys.
faithfully whatsoever thou doest to the: As becomes a believer and a Christian.

bring forward on their journey after: He commends to Gaius, either those same men whom he had entertained before returning to him, about the affairs of the Church, or else some other who had similar business.
fellowhelpers to the truth: That we ourselves may help the preaching of the truth.
I wrote unto the church: Ambition and covetousness, two pestilent sins (especially in those who have any church responsibilities) are condemned in Diotrephes.
seen God: Has not known God.
